Class TransferScenarios

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.TransferScenarios
final class TransferScenarios extends Object
Held-container transfer scenarios shared by every loader. Each right-clicks air with the main hand through GameTestSupport.useItem(Player, InteractionHand), so a foreign container in the main hand reaches the transfer through the loader's item-use event, and one of our buckets through its own use. Loader GameTest trees also carry the cases that must touch a loader event bus directly.
